commits.message:
test(traceback): pin an awaited call of a function named async (rich-traceback-dbs)

The comment on parseStack now names only the frame shapes it reads, since
it does not read every V8 shape. The shapes it misses are rich-traceback-9vcb
and rich-traceback-4es8.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(traceback): drop V8's async marker from frame names (rich-traceback-dbs)

`at async fn (file:l:c)` rendered `async fn`, and `at async file:l:c` folded
the marker into the path. The parser now reads the marker and drops it; a
lookahead keeps `at async (file:l:c)`, a function named `async`, a name.

The docs Max frames context now carries the tail Node 26 records, so its
rendered sample shows a nameless async frame.

test(embed): a bad style in any embedded label reaches onStyleError (rich-panel-z93) (#222)

* test(embed): a bad style in any embedded label degrades and reaches onStyleError (rich-panel-z93)

Markup and RichText spans in panel titles/subtitles landed in #173
(rich-panel-gbe). The ticket's remaining clause, that a style error there
degrades and reaches onStyleError, had no test; this pins it at every
embed site.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(embed): pin the unstyled bytes, a single report, and the RichText branch (rich-panel-z93)

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
